claim: Having a tx_id is not sending. A sprite, wall or sector sends its command only when it turns ON with trigger_on set or turns OFF with trigger_off set; a toggle lever with only trigger_on sends on every second push. Link is the exception: kSwitchCombo sends kCmdLink from its own path.
evidence: NBlood/source/blood/src/triggers.cpp:102-104 (SetSpriteState), :123-125 (SetWallState), :140 and the OFF branch below it (SetSectorState); kSwitchCombo's Link send at triggers.cpp:491.
Secrets built with secret=True omitted trigger_on and were never counted (found 2026-11-19).
use: Declare every wire on a Circuit, which refuses a sender reporting neither change; for a toggle say on and off.
